name: NACC
dev: Little Green Viper Software Development LLC

ios.desc:
This app is designed for NA members, and helps them to have a fun way to track and share their cleantime!

Enter your cleandate, and see the last tag or medallion you collected. You can then see ALL of the keytags and medallions that you should have.

Share your cleantime in Messages, or by email. Print out your cleantime, and stick it on your refrigerator!

quotes.story_title: The kind of company I want to be a part of
